Of Mandamus Or Any Other Writ Of Directing To The

Shop/Property Namely Urban Roots Hosur, Unkial
Road, Maryamman Timmasagar Colony Vidyanagar,
Hubballi.

This Writ Petition Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The petitioner is before this Court under Article 227 of the Constitution of India praying for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to remove the seal and lock put to the shop/property namely "Urban Roots", Hosur, Unkal Road, Hubballi.
2. The petitioner which is a partnership firm claims that it is a license holder for running Restaurant in Hubballi.
The said license is in force from 16.8.2019 to 15.08.2020.
The petitioner is lawfully running the business of vegetarian restaurant and cafe in the address stated above.

On 25.12.2019,
the respondents officials without any authority conducted the raid on the restaurant and locked the premises and sealed the same without following any due process of law.

3. On 20.1.2020, this Court directed Sri. G.I. Gachchinamath, learned counsel to take notice for the respondents and the matter was ordered to be listed to today to get instruction from the respondents.

4. Today, Sri. G.I. Gachchinamath, learned counsel for respondents 1 to 3 on instruction from the respondents submits that the petitioner-restaurant was raided and lock was put as the petitioner-Restaurant was unauthorisedly offering Hookah to their customers.
He further submits that the application for Trade License is pending and the petitioner has paid requisite fee towards consideration of the said application.
He would further submit that the respondents would consider the said application within a week and issue the Trade License to the petitioner.
5. Insofar as Hookah offered by the petitioner- Restaurant to their customers, the same is covered by the decision of this Court in WP No.4184/2017 (LB-BMP) decided on 20.02.2017.
6. In terms of the above order dated 20.02.2017 in WP No.4184/2017, the writ petition is disposed of.

However, the petitioner shall follow the norms prescribed under the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce,
Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003.
